title: ClinGen / CPIC / PharmGKB: clinical genomic and pharmacogenomic curation/actionability rail
summary: Infrastructure record for curated genomic and pharmacogenomic evidence rails that distinguish gene-disease validity, variant interpretation, gene-drug evidence, and clinical actionability rather than treating all genetic associations as equally actionable.

status_history.note: Promoted alongside positive control records to make curation/actionability rails explicit.

place.scope: NIH/NHGRI-related clinical genomics and pharmacogenomics curation infrastructure

claims.claim: NHGRI describes ClinGen as collecting phenotypic and clinical information on variants across the genome, developing consensus approaches to clinical relevance, and disseminating information to researchers and clinicians.
what_would_change_status: The NHGRI program page changes the description or scope of ClinGen.

claims.claim: NHGRI says ClinGen addresses the gap between widespread sequencing and limited clinically usable variant interpretation by developing standard approaches, expert consensus methods, data sharing, standards, scalable curation, expert review, diversity, and dissemination goals.
what_would_change_status: A current ClinGen methods source materially revises the stated goals or curation methods.

claims.claim: The ClinGen partnership page differentiates gene-disease/variant curation from pharmacogenetic gene-drug curation: CPIC provides evidence-based implementation guidelines and actionability levels, while PharmGKB manually curates variant-drug phenotype summaries, evidence ratings, drug labels, prescribing guidelines, and supporting PMIDs.
what_would_change_status: The partnership changes materially or later governance separates these functions.

evidence_profile.infrastructure_role: genomic evidence curation and actionability rail

type_payload.signal_capture_model: expert curation of gene-disease, variant pathogenicity, clinical actionability, and gene-drug evidence using documented frameworks and evidence ratings
outputs: standardized vocabularies and downloadable/searchable curation surfaces
limitations: Curation/actionability rails do not make every association clinically usable.
Coverage, update cadence, disagreement resolution, population diversity, and clinical implementation require record-specific review.
Not a primary trial/study registry and not a substitute for clinical judgment.

handling_notes: Genetic findings must not be represented as deterministic individual destiny.
No clinical advice, testing advice, or individual-level participant data is encoded.
Population/ancestry, phenotype, and actionability scope must remain visible.

unknowns: Exact current update cadence and versioning for every relevant curation surface.
How to encode disagreement among curators or guideline bodies.
next_actions: Add ClinGen gene-disease validity methods source.
Tie pharmacogenomic controls to specific guideline version records.

scope_qualifiers.phenotype_scope: clinical genomic and pharmacogenomic curation rails
scope_qualifiers.ancestry_or_population_scope: curation/actionability is variant/drug/disease and population dependent
scope_qualifiers.portability_caution: guidelines do not make all associations actionable
